In [[3653 BBY]], the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] convened to '''elect''' a new [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] to lead the democratic government. After the [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] of the [[Berooken|previous Chancellor]] during an [[Sacking of Coruscant|assault]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] perpetrated by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Paran Am-Ris]] took control of Senate activities for an interim period. When the [[Time/Legends|time]] came to elect the Chancellor formally, the Senate voted unanimously to install Senator [[Dorian Janarus]] of Coruscant, in recognition of his strong leadership of the planet in the crisis's aftermath.

==Background==
The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] had been enmeshed in the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] for a number of [[Time/Legends|decades]]<ref name="T6">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire}}</ref> by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="Deceived">''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''</ref> when the Empire ended the war with a [[Sacking of Coruscant|surprise attack]]. The Empire's forces invaded the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="T1" /> while the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic's military forces]] were focused on outlying areas of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="Aric">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|The Coruscant Assignment|Coruscant}}</ref> and the two factions had envoys [[Alderaan peace conference|negotiating a peace treaty]]. The Sith overwhelmed Coruscant quickly. The [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] was ransacked,<ref name="T1" /> [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Berooken]] was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]], and the devastated [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] was held for ransom by the Sith so they could compel the Republic's peace envoy to sign the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]<ref name="TOP1" /> that forced it to divide the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] between the two factions and abandon allies in the outer regions in exchange for ending hostilities. This brought about a [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the two factions.<ref name="T1" /> Until an election could be held to formally select a new Chancellor, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Paran Am-Ris]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cerea/Legends|Cerea]] was appointed for the interim.<ref name="TOP1" />

==Candidates==
Senator [[Dorian Janarus]] was a representative of Coruscant in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] for many years before the emergence of the Sith Empire in [[3681 BBY]] and the [[Assault on the Tingel Arm region|beginning]] of the Great Galactic War, but the war made him a prominent figure.<ref name="JCodex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Supreme Chancellor Janarus}}</ref> While he felt his position was fulfilling, he always aspired to gain the Chancellorship and the prestige that came with it. Having survived the Sacking of Coruscant himself, Janarus took charge in its aftermath,<ref name="Holo" /> assessing the damage and directing efforts to help the people in their time of need. He was viewed as a great leader not only to the [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]], but also to the entire Republic for these deeds.<ref name="TORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Election and aftermath==
The Coruscanti people and the Republic's [[Politics/Legends|politicians]] were glutted by hope in response to the leadership of Senator Janarus.<ref name="TORE" /> The thousands of representatives in the Galactic Senate<ref name="Gov">{{TORcite|type=codex|Republic Government}}</ref> voted unanimously to promote Janarus to Supreme Chancellor,<ref name="Holo" /> and he relieved Am-Ris<ref name="TOP1" /> to begin the office's four year term.<ref name="Gov" />

In the years after his election to the position, Janarus's support waned as the costs to rebuild Coruscant grew: many of the Republic's representative [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] were strained economically by this. He was also disliked by the military, who were irritated by his refusal to combat sedition in the government.<ref name="JCodex" /> Despite this, Janarus was re-elected to his position in [[Supreme Chancellor election, 3649 BBY|3649]] and [[Supreme Chancellor election, 3645 BBY|3645 BBY]].<ref name="reelection">Janarus was the incumbent Supreme Chancellor in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which has early events in the [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] class that must occur in [[3643 BBY]] due to [[Flesh Raider uprising#cite_note-Time-3|statements in various tie-in materials]]. The in-game Codex's "Republic Government" entry stated that "in recent years" there were campaigns for the position of Supreme Chancellor. Since portions of the game took place ten years after Janarus was elected, there must have been at least two election cycles in the intervening years.</ref> These were small affairs as the candidates feared assassination by the Sith Empire.<ref name="Gov" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dorian Janarus was an influential character in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]].<ref name="TheOldRepublic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> To hype their game, BioWare released a number of articles through the game's official website, in [[the Holonet]] section, that provided background information on various subjects. Janarus's article documented his unanimous election to the position of Supreme Chancellor, which he occupied until his [[Death/Legends|death]] in the game.<ref name="Holo" />
